description: Staged S3 objects of the Phase 12D isolated EMR spike, for the per-attempt request upper bound. Every aws_s3_object in infra/terraform/spikes/emr-spark-isolated must be listed here (request_bound.py enforces it).

assumptions.provider_upload_note: terraform-provider-aws 6.44.0 aws_s3_object uploads through the AWS SDK for Go v2 s3 manager Uploader (symbols feature/s3/manager.Uploader.Upload and s3.resourceObjectUpload observed by `strings` on the provider binary). The manager default part size is 5 MiB (SDK default, not observed in the binary); the 64 MiB figure in the work order applies only if the provider overrides it, which was not observed. 5 MiB is used because it is the larger request count.
assumptions.cli_note: AWS CLI v2 default multipart_threshold and multipart_chunksize are 8 MiB; used for node downloads, the collect upload and the evidence download.
assumptions.emr_log_pusher_note: ASSUMPTION, not observed: EMR pushes new or changed log files about every 5 minutes (documented interval) and the number of changed objects per push is not documented. 8 per push plus a 60-object final flush is a stated estimate. The retry multiplier is NOT applied to it because the estimate is already pessimistic; changing it changes the bound linearly.
